newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Hansapank eyes more international issues.
newsitem.headline: Hansapank eyes more international issues.

text.p: Largest Estonian bank Hansapank said on Friday that from now on it plans to tap the international capital markets twice a year for funds.
The bank, which is also the largest in the Baltic states, earlier announced it was to sign a three-year 100 million mark loan with a syndicate of 29 banks led by Bank Gesellschaft Berlin on March 14.
"We are planning to be in the market twice a year," Hansapank fixed income chief Erkki Raasuke told Reuters.
He said the bank was thinking of a eurobond issue but had not decided of what maturity or size.
He said that any future issue would probably be in marks again. -- Patrick Lannin, Riga Newsroom, +371 721 5240
